title: Composable compliance credits and per-route premium SLA experiment
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: validate a composable add-on model that lets customers mix 'compliance credits' (audit/log retention tiers), per-route premium SLA, and an opt-in observability retention window. Hypothesis: a credits-based compliance product plus a per-route SLA meter will increase ARR from enterprise customers without increasing churn if pricing is transparent and onboarding friction is low. Scope: prototype UI flows in Console for adding credits and attaching them to routes; backend billing telemetry to record per-route SLA consumption; gates to enforce feature availability by entitlement. Non-goals: full billing integration (we will mock charge flows), on-prem package changes, and legal contract language updates in this experiment. Success metrics: 1) +10% trial-to-paid conversion for targeted enterprise cohort; 2) average add-on revenue per committing tenant >= $750/mo; 3) no increase in P1 support incidents related to quota confusion; 4) feature adoption on at least 8% of routes for pilot tenants. Constraints & trade-offs: prefer simple UX over maximal configurability for initial rollout; use consumption-based credits rather than fixed subscription tiers to reduce sales negotiation surface; risk of billing complexity will be mitigated by instrumentation and limited pilot. Stakeholders: PM (Maya), Sales AE (Priya Patel), Solutions Eng (Diego Ramos), Legal (Anika Verma), Billing Eng (Ruth Kim), Console UX (Jordan Hayes).
acceptance_criteria: Console: Add-ons page shows 'Compliance credits' SKU and allows purchase simulation for pilot tenants
Console: Route settings UI allows assignment of an add-on SKU to a specific API route with clear units (days of retention, SLA tier)
Backend: Telemetry emitted for per-route SLA breaches and credit consumption (mock billing events available in staging dashboard)
Entitlements: Feature gate evaluates correctly for pilot tenants and prevents exposure to non-pilot accounts
Experiment: Instrumented funnel in Amplitude/Looker with conversion and revenue KPIs
Docs: Internal runbook + sales one-pager and onboarding checklist created and reviewed
